input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds Customer anywhere in the Agreement. Section 12.3 expressly confirms that nothing restricts Customer from acquiring, licensing or using any product or service or engaging any supplier, and that Customer has made no exclusivity or minimum-volume commitment; Section 2.1 reinforces this ("No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies"). The only exclusivity-flavoured covenant (Section 12.4, Vendor shall not market a competing service) runs in our favour and is not flagged. The licence grant in 13.1 is expressly non-exclusive. This sits at the preferred position, so no redline is proposed.
